title: NetBox Data Link Plugin
description: AGPL-3.0 NetBox 4.6 plugin: native SoT for switch data-link (L2) control-plane features — STP, LLDP, DHCP snooping — replacing unstructured config_context. Per-device singleton configs (OneToOne dcim.Device) plus per-port child overrides (OneToOne dcim.Interface).

phases.title: Plugin scaffold + models
phases.exit_criteria: Six NetBoxModel models with choices, hand-authored 0001_initial migration, full UI + REST surface, mirroring netbox-pf conventions.

items.feature: Hand-authored migrations/0001_initial (dcim.Device + dcim.Interface FK deps, ArrayField)

phases.title: Plugin surface (filters, forms, tables, views, API)
phases.exit_criteria: NetBoxModelFilterSet/Table/Form/views per model; REST NetBoxModelViewSet contract; navigation menu.

items.feature: FilterSets (filter by device + interface) + filter forms
Forms (NumericArrayField for vlans) + tables + views + urls + navigation
REST API serializers + viewsets + router urls

phases.title: Tests (NO MOCKS — real NetBox test DB)
phases.exit_criteria: Every model/serializer/filterset/view covered, including per-interface child models; suite green against the NetBox test DB.

items.feature: test_models (str/url/color, OneToOne per-device + per-interface uniqueness, CASCADE, ArrayField round-trip)

phases.title: Deploy validation (blocked — needs a NetBox instance)
phases.description: NetBox is not installable in the build environment (imports netbox.*), so makemigrations --check and the test suite cannot run here. Run these on the NetBox CT (74234) or an ephemeral NetBox before deploy.
phases.exit_criteria: makemigrations --check is a no-op (hand-authored migration matches the models) AND the full test suite is green on a real NetBox.

items.feature: python manage.py makemigrations netbox_data_link --check --dry-run is a no-op
python manage.py test netbox_data_link --keepdb -v2 passes (all models/api/filtersets)
